sample: 41 reviewer-authored same-input cases from 12 qids: T1=8, T2=8, T3=8, T4=8, T5=4, T6=4, T7=1. T7 is medium ambiguity and reported separately.
arms: A rewrites complete state with JSON/schema/ref validation only. B proposes a Delta and commits mechanically valid semantics without Verify. C uses exactly B's prompt and schema, then triggers Verify on status transitions or semantically dependent gap closure; failed Verify retains previous committed status.
mutation_unit: One claim status change, one claim statement or evidence-ref change without status change, one new claim, or one gap status change. ControlProjection active-gap retirement is reported separately. Correct mutation matches required id/status and cites the new observation ref when specified. Unrequired mutations are churn; unsupported new claims are promotion.
false_closure: Case-level count of any committed open-to-supported/refuted claim not allowed by reviewer labels; report over 17 T3/T4/T7 at-risk cases and separately over all 41 cases. A verifier rejection is a proposed error but not a committed false closure.
missed_closure: Required supported/refuted claim stays open after the arm completes; report over the 28 target cases T1/T2/T5/T6, with T5's three claims counted individually in claim-level recall.
evidence_binding: A required claim mutation must cite the currently observed new W ref; C verifier receives exact cited text, plus earlier verified text when reopening. Refs must map to this case's packet-local observed W# identities.
unrelated_churn: Any final change to a reviewer-forbidden Claim or nonrequired Gap, including changed statement or refs, counts per case. Full Rewrite may not receive semantic repair. Mechanical invalidity is reported separately and scores zero correct mutations.
NoGain_preservation: For T4, VerifiedProgress Claims and Gaps remain semantically identical; ControlProjection is assessed separately.
stale_active_gap: If the model proposes to keep a gap it also closes, record proposed stale. Transactional commit mechanically retires a closed active gap under invariant I7. A full rewrite is not semantically repaired.

gate.G1: B or C versus A has at least four paired cases with less unrelated state churn; reverse worsening count is less than half improvement count.
gate.G2: C committed false closure <=10% of 17 T3/T4/T7 at-risk cases.
gate.G3: C mutation precision >=80% across committed semantic state mutations.
gate.G4: At least 80% of T4 NoGain cases preserve VerifiedProgress unchanged in C.

failure_policy: Exactly one A/B/C Updater request per case in rotating order, zero retries, all errors and invalid JSON retained. Verifier calls occur only by predeclared trigger; errors reject transition without retry. No best-of or selective replacement.
